topic: Technical documentation for JCD data format
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on locating and finalizing the technical specification for submitting data to the jcd bucket. The required format involves using `item-v3` structure, but the overall payload must be an array containing objects structured by facility location.

The correct format requires a root object that contains a list of facilities (locations). Each facility entry must include its unique Facility ID (`id`) and a nested array (`data`) containing hourly items for that specific location. The `facilityId` within the nested items should duplicate the top-level facility identifier.

A Swagger document was updated to reflect this structure, and a corresponding internal documentation link was shared and confirmed.
decisions: The technical specification for jcd data submission has been finalized.
The format requires an array root containing objects keyed by Facility ID.
action_items: Review the updated Swagger document at github.[redacted].
Use the provided internal documentation link (http://docs.allunite.local/dataflow/uploading_jcdecaux) as the official guide for data submission.
